extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: industrial electrical switch cabinet, 1.2 m wide, 0.5 m deep, 2.0 m tall
extras.notes: two door leaves are separate objects (door_left, door_right) with their origin on the hinge axis: rotate around local Z, door_left opens with a negative angle, door_right with a positive angle (up to about 110 degrees); the three indicator lamps on the left door glow (emissive) and are parented to it; inside: cream mounting plate with three rows of circuit breakers, cable ducts and terminal strip; plinth with yellow and dark hazard stripes; front = -Y; no text, no symbols

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
